assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-50.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry.
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat.
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis code I34.0 is associated with the condition.
The diagnosis code R00.2 is associated with palpitations.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period.
The payer's finding was that documentation did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring over the specified period.
